nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Core module implementing the generic channel abstraction (GenericSender/GenericReceiver) that transparently selects between IPC and crossbeam channels based on multiprocess configuration, with serialization, error types, and routing support.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a OnceLock cache for IPC mode detection and serde enum-based serialization to handle cross-process channel transport.
